selection_policy: Twenty new instances, none reused from V1, selected from static task metadata before any V2 agent trial. V2 labels are study strata, not an official FeatBench difficulty field.

very_hard.reason: Ten F2P tests and 971 test-patch lines across a broad response surface.
Eight F2P tests and 272 test-patch lines across a broad API surface.

exclusions: All ten V1 instances, to keep V2 a genuinely new task block.
Known deterministic-failure and flaky V1 instances documented by the Harbor FeatBench adapter, including cfn-lint, Conan 16317/16848, tox 3534, and xarray tasks.
notes: All candidates are CPU-only, Dockerfile-backed Harbor tasks intended for a single E2B container.
The oracle/reference patch must pass both F2P and P2P before a task is eligible for the 140 V2 trials.
Difficulty strata are frozen selection metadata, not labels inferred from agent outcomes.
